description.value: Rogers Forum (formerly Abbotsford Centre) is Abbotsford's premier indoor sports and entertainment arena, home to the Abbotsford Canucks — the 2025 AHL Calder Cup Champions and the AHL affiliate of the Vancouver Canucks. The venue hosts a busy calendar of concerts, comedy shows, and live sports drawing roughly 200,000 visitors per year from across the Fraser Valley and BC's Lower Mainland. A touring cyclist passing through Abbotsford will find a fully accessible, full-service event venue on King Road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rogersforum.com is fully accessible and confirms this is an active, publicly accessible arena hosting concerts and Abbotsford Canucks AHL games with upcoming events through late 2026. The OSM name 'Abbotsford Centre' is outdated per the OSM note itself — the venue was renamed Rogers Forum in November 2025, corroborated by the website. No explicit bike parking, washroom, or water refill content appears in the fetched pages, but the 'Food & Beverage' navigation item under 'Plan Your Visit' confirms food service on site; all other amenities remain unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM name 'Abbotsford Centre' is outdated; the venue was officially renamed 'Rogers Forum' in November 2025. The OSM record's own note acknowledges this and states Wikidata must be updated for the new name to take effect. The website exclusively uses 'Rogers Forum'.
OSM record has no phone number listed; website contact page provides 604.743.5000 as the main number.
